scope: Independent read-only presentation review, protected-source byte comparison, one existing 59-test run and one fast 80-equation math guard. Fresh browser and alpha/crop reports are reviewed and hash-pinned; historical full mathematics evidence is preserved without rerunning its large replay or crypto sample.

readOnlyRuntimeInspection.receiptWalletAndInput: Production round selection, commit, balance settlement, pending replay, settled-only legacy wallet migration, DEV-only fixture hooks, and held-key input guards are byte-identical to b8f8762. Renderer layout and pose selection operate on committed receipts and do not draw gameplay entropy.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.foreground: A transparent full-stage character canvas uses pointer-events:none and aria-hidden, below controls. It maps the board transform onto the full viewport so cast gestures are drawn once without the reel mask; an original speaker outside the narrower board canvas remains a valid visible desktop seat.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.poses: All three characters have 16 source drawings. Pose envelopes use source anchors and per-frame reference heights; release is frame 8. Reduced motion retains idle/release/settle poses, suppresses decorative recoil and preserves recorded settlement.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.luxSeat: LUX is a separate seated sprite with a pelvis anchor. Desktop contact projects original scene pixels (1394,406) through CSS cover. Portrait and win-scene cabinet crops use the same original source window (1318,390,266,425) and silhouette; the background PNG is byte-identical to baseline.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.celebration: All action atlases decode before count-up. Positive moving and settle holds support 16 drawings, gesture envelopes fit settled actors, and the separate original-source cabinet paints behind seated LUX inside the isolated win scene.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.audioAndMathematics: Audio code/config/all WAVs, payline chart, engine, types, frozen model and verification code are byte-identical to baseline.
